pages.raw_meta: Texas Roadhouse is a legendary steak restaurant serving American cuisine from the best steaks and ribs to made-from-scratch sides & fresh-baked rolls.
raw_blocks: We're hiring! Learn more about careers at Texas Roadhouse.
IF IT DOESN'T SAY TEXAS, IT'S NOT TEXAS ROADHOUSE®
Legendary means Hand-Cut Steaks, Fall-Off-The-Bone Ribs, Made-From-Scratch Sides, Ice-Cold Beer, and of course, our irresistible Fresh-Baked Bread.
Kent Taylor opened the first Texas Roadhouse in Clarksville, Indiana, in 1993.
Today's made-from-scratch food (at a great value) and legendary service began with a dream sketched on a cocktail napkin.
Texas Roadhouse's employee assistance fund, Andy's Outreach, is one of the ways we help our employees who are experiencing a financial hardship. It is funded for Roadies by Roadies.
We proudly serve USDA Choice steaks, hand-cut by our in-house Meat Cutters. Always fresh, never frozen.
From the 3-day preparation process to our signature BBQ sauce, our ribs are flavorful and fork-tender.
Legendary Food, Legendary Service® starts with taking no shortcuts. We take great pride in every plate we serve, every time.
Tip A Cop for Special Olympics
GIVING BACK TO COMMUNITIES WE SERVE
We reduce energy consumption with high-efficiency kitchen equipment and internal LED lights.
Less food waste is a great byproduct of our made-from-scratch model because we can make use of excess product.
Most of our locations recycle their fryer oil for biofuel.
Reach out about a recent visit or order, or anything else that's on your mind.
